snp5.13:1.1:
I entreat the one who has
abandoned home—cutting through craving, unperturbed;
snp5.13:1.3: abandoned delight—crossed over the flood, released;
snp5.13:2.1:
hero,
in hopes of your words.
snp5.13:2.4:
how this Dhamma has
been known to you.
snp5.13:3.3:
all—
above, below,
across, in between.
snp5.13:3.4: For whatever people cling to in the world,
snp5.13:3.5:
it’s through that
that Māra pursues them.
snp5.13:4.3:
seeing these people
entangled in grasping
snp5.13:4.4:
as entangled in Death’s realm,
should cling to nothing
in all the world,
every world.
